title: M4: Automation in the set: automate lanes as envelopes on mixer and device controls
description:
## Purpose

The score's `automate` lines become the set's automation envelopes on the matching mixer controls and device parameters, with the same shape over time: ramps, steps, jumps, and frequency sweeps that move by octaves.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A["automate eq.highcut 1=20k 3=6k"] --> L["Lane (target, step, points)"]
  L --> P[device parameter in the set]
  L --> E["envelope breakpoints (beats, stored units)"]
```

## Scope

Every automation target `docs/language.md` lists: `volume`, `pan`, `send <return>`, `filter`, `eq.highcut`, `eq.lowcut`, `eq.low`, `eq.high`, `comp.threshold`, `comp.mix`, `reverb.mix`, `delay.mix`, `width`, and numbered devices (`eq2.highcut`), on tracks, group and return tracks.

2. Rust in `apricity-daw` (`Lane` from `TrackInfo.automation` / `BusInfo.automation`). Python parity: not applicable.
3. Schema: not applicable.
4. CLI: no new flags; warnings located by the automate line.
5. Fixtures: the M0 reference `automation.als`; no audio.
6. Design: `design/daw-set.md` automation section (targets, units, curve approximation).
7. Docs: `docs/language.md` Automation section gains a line on how it lands in a DAW set; concepts DAW section.
8. Web: none.
9. Verification: `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw`; manual: the `automate` example from `docs/language.md` opened in the DAW, envelopes visible and audible.
10. Running log. 11. `feat(<task id>)` per task; not breaking.
12. Depends on M3 (devices and mixer controls to point at).
